result-meta.purpose: Source domain above the result title.

shadows.name: floating-search-help
shadows.purpose: Only the open search-help popover; primary workbench surfaces remain flat.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: CSS control transitions and mobile navigation; the same control points drive the Motion drawer.

motion.name: control-transition
motion.purpose: CSS background, color and search-border state changes.

motion.name: facet-chevron
motion.purpose: CSS rotation of expanded facet chevrons.

motion.name: mobile-navigation
motion.purpose: CSS translation of the mobile sidebar.

motion.name: tab-indicator
motion.purpose: GSAP owns indicator x and width; changes continue from current position.

motion.name: focus-reading
motion.purpose: GSAP owns desktop pane x; previous timelines are killed and final transform is cleared.

motion.name: reader-drawer
motion.purpose: Motion owns drawer x from/to 100%; desktop GSAP does not target this element.

motion.name: drawer-overlay
motion.purpose: Motion owns overlay opacity with its default easing.

motion.name: reading-progress
motion.purpose: Motion owns progress scaleX derived from actual reader scroll position.

motion.name: busy-spinner
motion.purpose: CSS rotation for a real loading state.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: immediate state changes; direct progress; auto scrolling
motion.purpose: CSS disables animation/transition, GSAP and drawers use zero duration, and progress bypasses its spring.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: Plum action with a compact radius; disabled and keyboard-focus states are included.
components.html: <button class="ds-primary" type="button">导入书签 · Import bookmarks</button>
components.css: .ds-primary{font-family:"Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif;font-size:14px;line-height:1.6;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;border:0;border-radius:6px;font-size:13px;font-weight:550;line-height:1.5;min-height:36px;cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s var(--ease, cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1));}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent, #7255c1);outline-offset:3px;}.ds-primary:disabled{cursor:not-allowed;opacity:.42;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-primary{transition:none!important;animation:none!important;}}.ds-primary{padding:10px 16px;background:var(--accent, #7255c1);color:var(--on-accent, #fff);}.ds-primary:hover:not(:disabled){filter:brightness(.94);}

components.name: Secondary button
components.description: Outlined action for testing, retrying and subordinate operations.
components.html: <button class="ds-secondary" type="button">测试连接 · Test connection</button>
components.css: .ds-secondary{font-family:"Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", sans-serif;font-size:14px;line-height:1.6;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;border:0;border-radius:6px;font-size:13px;font-weight:550;line-height:1.5;min-height:36px;cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s var(--ease, cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1));}.ds-secondary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent, #7255c1);outline-offset:3px;}.ds-secondary:disabled{cursor:not-allowed;opacity:.42;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-secondary{transition:none!important;animation:none!important;}}.ds-secondary{padding:9px 14px;border:1px solid var(--rule, #e9e8ef);background:var(--canvas, #ffffff);color:var(--ink, #282831);}.ds-secondary:hover:not(:disabled){background:var(--inset, #f5f5f8);}

components.name: Text button
components.description: Small plum inline action with a hover underline.

components.name: Search field
components.description: Inset global search field; the container changes to white with a plum border on focus.
components.html: Ctrl K

narrative.overview:
Facetmark is an index beside an open reading desk. Porcelain white working surfaces, faint violet-grey navigation, graphite text and plum selection marks make finding a saved thought and reading its source feel continuous. Small controls and ruled rows establish precision; generous prose establishes a different pace for reading.

The workbench keeps Facetmark’s layered mark and independent identity. Its brightness and order continue the approved direction, while the settled implementation uses source-first rows and a stable reader. The shared React interface serves the Tauri desktop shell, Python distribution and Docker image, with local Chinese and English typography and matching light/dark semantic roles.
keyCharacteristics: White working surfaces and pale navigation, separated by fine rules.
Source, title, excerpt and folder form a compact result hierarchy.
Fixed reader controls frame an independently scrolling article.
Focus reading expands within the same workspace; narrow windows use a modal drawer.
Plum marks actions and selection; restrained motion preserves context.

rules.name: One Accent
rules.body: Use plum for actions, focus and selected-state details. Keep result titles graphite, including selected rows, and reserve the danger role for failures.

rules.name: Reading Rhythm
rules.body: Keep controls and source metadata compact while giving article text generous leading and paragraph space. Wrap Chinese text, long titles and URLs without widening the workspace.

rules.name: Flat Surfaces
rules.body: Use pale tone and fine rules for structural separation. Reserve the small shadow for floating search help and the scrim for modal depth.

dos: Do keep the light workspace white, the navigation pale and structural edges straight.
Do preserve the source-first result order and graphite selected titles.
Do keep reader actions and tabs outside the article scroller.
Do preserve query, filters, pagination and list position when expanding and restoring reading.
Do bind both themes to the same semantic roles and retain local Chinese/English font fallbacks.
Do provide visible focus, keyboard navigation, reduced motion and distinct recovery states.
Do show measured reading position only when saved body text is available.
donts: Don't turn the result list into raised cards, large source avatars or a candy-colored dashboard.
Don't reintroduce a dark navigation frame in the light theme, an inset rounded workspace shell or hand-drawn borders.
Don't add promotional labels to the compact search toolbar.
Don't let GSAP, Motion and CSS animate the same property on the same element.
Don't invent reading percentages, inferred section headings or successful task states.
